# TextFill

Super simple implementation for resizing text to fit in a container. This was probably a waste of time.

### Installing

```
npm install textfill --save
```

### Example

```
import { textFill } from 'textfill';

...

let elem = document.getElementById('target');
textFill(elem);
```
